The challenge

Operational complexity shouldn't slow your business down.

As pharmaceutical businesses grow, teams spend valuable time handling repetitive enquiries, coordinating orders and following up on supplier documentation.

01

Enquiry Overload

Routine customer and distributor enquiries consume staff time and can become difficult to track.

02

Order Coordination

Order details, SKU information, quantities and status requests often move between multiple people and systems.

03

Supplier Documentation

Missing documents, expiry dates and repeated supplier follow-ups create unnecessary administrative work.

04

Limited Process Visibility

When workflows are spread across emails, spreadsheets and disconnected systems, it is harder to see what is outstanding and who is responsible.

TERONA brings structure, consistency and visibility to these everyday processes.

Our solutions

Solutions built around your operations.

SOLUTION 01

Enquiry Management

A structured enquiry-handling solution to manage routine customer and distributor requests.

  • Capture incoming enquiries
  • Classify by request type
  • Collect customer & product information
  • Respond using approved business information
  • Route to the right department
  • Escalate sensitive or complex enquiries
  • Maintain visibility of status

Manage incoming requests more consistently while reducing repetitive administrative work.

Explore Enquiry Management →
SOLUTION 02

Order Coordination

Organise incoming order information and improve communication between customers and internal teams.

  • Capture order-related requests
  • Collect SKU and product details
  • Record quantities and delivery info
  • Handle routine order-status enquiries
  • Route requests to the right team
  • Identify incomplete information
  • Track outstanding tasks

A more organised order-information process with less back-and-forth between customers and staff.

Explore Order Coordination →
SOLUTION 03

Supplier Documentation

Track document requests, outstanding records and follow-up activities.

  • Record requested supplier documents
  • Identify missing documentation
  • Track expiry dates where configured
  • Send follow-up reminders
  • Maintain request status
  • Escalate outstanding items
  • Overview of pending follow-ups

Better visibility over supplier-document follow-ups with less administrative effort.

Explore Supplier Documentation →

These workflows support administrative coordination. They do not independently approve suppliers, validate pharmaceutical quality, certify documents or make regulated quality decisions.

Chemo Healthcare

Case study 01 · Chemo Healthcare · India

Live

Building a predictable pipeline of international distributors

The challenge

With reach across 60+ countries, the constraint wasn't demand — it was time. Finding distributors, keeping discussions warm and answering repetitive documentation requests competed for limited business development bandwidth, and quiet prospects went cold.

Outcome

A referral-and-trade-fair motion turned into a measurable, repeatable export pipeline.

What TERONA built

  • Market-matched prospecting across Africa, GCC, CIS, LATAM and Southeast Asia
  • Personalised LinkedIn and email outreach by country and therapeutic focus
  • Automatic qualification on products, regulatory needs and buying intent
  • One pipeline for every enquiry, contact and opportunity
  • Instant delivery of company profile, catalogue and certifications
  • Persistent follow-up and full deal tracking to purchase order
  • Doctor engagement layer for new-product information

Dermatouch

Case study 02 · Dermatouch · India · Dermatology

Live

An AI voice call centre that announces every new product to every doctor

The challenge

New-product news travelled only as fast as medical representatives could. A launch could take weeks to reach the full doctor base.

Outcome

16 batches, 28 Feb – 27 Mar 2026: 76 sales-ready doctor conversations and 79 opted-in WhatsApp contacts in one month.

What TERONA built

  • AI voice calls to the entire doctor database at launch
  • Product-aware conversations on indication and availability
  • Live outcome capture on every call
  • Warm hand-off to sales and instant WhatsApp literature
  • Campaign analytics dashboard by batch, funnel and trend

Intercontinental Pharma

Case study 03 · Intercontinental Pharma · USA

Engagement blueprint

Opening US institutional and specialty channels without adding headcount

The challenge

US access spans wholesalers, GPOs, specialty pharmacies, IDNs and 340B institutions — each with its own contracting cycle and documentation demands.

Intended result

Designed to give a reachable contact for every priority account and free BD time for contracting.

What TERONA deploys

  • Account mapping across wholesalers, GPOs, IDNs and hospital procurement
  • Sequences built around each account's therapeutic mix
  • Qualification on formulary fit, authority and volume potential
  • Instant cGMP, FDA and cold-chain documentation
  • One pipeline from first contact to purchase order

ScieGen Pharmaceuticals

Case study 04 · ScieGen Pharmaceuticals · USA

Engagement blueprint

A repeatable generics pipeline across wholesalers, GPOs and tenders

The challenge

In generics, the team that responds first with complete documentation usually wins. Manual monitoring and document assembly cost days.

Intended result

Designed for faster, more complete tender responses and clear visibility of molecule demand.

What TERONA deploys

  • Continuous discovery of wholesalers, GPO members and tender desks per molecule
  • Portfolio-aware outreach by product, strength and pack size
  • Automated documentation pack sent on request
  • Re-engagement of dormant accounts
  • Tracking from enquiry to award and purchase order

Advanz Pharma

Case study 05 · Advanz Pharma · Canada

Engagement blueprint

Partner discovery for a specialty and orphan portfolio

The challenge

Specialty and orphan products need the right partner per territory — with regulatory capability, cold-chain and clinical access. Vetting them country by country is slow.

Intended result

Designed to deliver a vetted partner shortlist per territory and keep registration conversations moving.

What TERONA deploys

  • Territory-by-territory partner identification
  • Outreach personalised to each partner's portfolio
  • Qualification on regulatory, cold-chain and clinical capability
  • Structured follow-through to registration and purchase order
  • Optional doctor and KOL engagement layer

Engagement blueprints are scoped from the Chemo Healthcare and Dermatouch systems and are not completed client deployments.
